method: Independent source/XAML image completion and backend update boundary challenge
severity_assessment: HIGH conditional authorized menu-integrity risk, native ComboBox reload behavior untested.

evidence.evidence: CanBrowse/CanEdit omit IsImageBusy; selection/new/save can remain enabled during image HTTP wait.
Selecting B resets/populates form fields and _editing=B while image request for captured A still pending.
ChooseImageAsync captures product A before picker/upload awaits then sets _editing=A on success without generation check.
RemoveImageAsync has same unconditional captured-product restore after network await.
ReloadAsync rebuilds categories/recipes/catalogue but never resets visible Name/Price/Variants or _editing. CategoryChoices clear/rebuild may affect native bound selection and must be tested.
Validated mutable form fields are combined with _editing ProductDetailsDto.Id; category membership and station gates still must pass.
Catalogue row command remains available; no image-busy parent exclusion shown.
Only image buttons use CanEditImage/IsImageBusy; save binds CanEdit at376.

Actual authorized backend updates requested product identity. Foreign variant ID is NOT rejected: if not found among target variants it creates a new variant, and removes target old variants not in keepIds.

supported_interleaving: A image upload/delete pending; select B; A success sets _editing back to A and invokes reload; B mutable Name/Price/Variants remain; after required category/station validation passes, Save constructs UpdateProductRequest targeting A with current B-derived fields.
preconditions: Authorized menu manager opens existing product A image action and switches to B during network await.
Image operation succeeds and operator later submits current form with valid category/station; native choice reset may require explicitly reselecting a category.
Real backend accepts otherwise valid request; no bypass of menu_manage required.
counterevidence: Native file picker may prevent interaction while open; upload/delete HTTP await remains an independent window.
Reload IsLoading temporarily disables CanBrowse/CanEdit. It does not itself restore form-target coherence.
Native ComboBox clearing CategoryChoices may reset Category, causing validation rejection until corrected; no native control observation executed.
Careful operator may notice image change.
Original report suggestion that foreign variant IDs may be rejected is contradicted by actual ProductHandlers.cs129-142 fallback creation; do not retain that as verified mitigation.
recommended_remediation: Keep immutable image target separate from current editor, and publish only when selection generation still matches; maintain coherent form identity through reload and coordinate image action with browse/save.
required_tests: Controlled upload/delete A completion after selecting B must not replace B editor identity.
Assert native CategoryChoices refresh behavior and correct saved target after any required reselect.
Backend fixture verifies foreign-variant fallback behavior separately; no production mutations needed.
Repeat New/SetKind/Close/reopen while image response delayed.
independent_scope: UI-021 only, no exhaustive callable certification
